I am deleting this app after a very disappointing start to using the app. Was preparing for a trip out of the US. I ordered a card and paid the extra shipping fee to expedite the card arriving before I left. Without any indication that it would be sent this way they required a signature to receive the card. When I missed the first delivery I tried to sign digitally with UPS. Was informed by UPS that Wise that wasn’t an option because of Wise policy. Have received every other credit card without signature as card is not valid until activation. Left on trip without a card and tried to transfer money into account to be used with digital card. 5 days later after still no money I cancelled the bank transfer. Company told me it was all on me to be there to receive the card and refused to refund fee I paid. Completely unsatisfied I am cancelling the account.
